elastic/kibana#900101.title: [Security Solution][Alerts] Run a workflow from the alerts table row actions
elastic/kibana#900101.body:
## Description
Add a `Run workflow` entry to the row actions of the alerts table, so analysts can run a workflow for one alert without leaving the alerts page.

When the user clicks `Run workflow`, a secondary panel opens (like `Apply alert tags`). It shows a search bar, the list of workflows available for the alert, and a `Run workflow` button.

After the user runs a workflow, a toast confirms that the execution started. If the execution id is available, the toast has a `View execution` button that opens the execution in Workflows.

## Acceptance criteria
- The row actions menu shows `Run workflow` when the user can run workflows.
- The panel lists only workflows that accept an alert as input, and the search filters them by name.
- Running a workflow shows the confirmation toast; `View execution` opens the execution.
- Users without the Workflows privilege do not see the entry.

elastic/kibana#900102.title: [Security Solution][Bug] Timeline search bar does not apply the query
elastic/kibana#900102.body:
**Describe the bug:**
Typing a KQL query in the Timeline search bar and pressing Enter does not filter the events.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Open Timeline.
2. Type `host.name : "web-01"` and press Enter.

**Current behavior:** all events are still shown.

**Expected behavior:** only events from `web-01` are shown.

elastic/security-team#900200.title: [Epic] Security dashboards move to native Kibana Dashboards
elastic/security-team#900200.body:
## Summary
Security wraps the platform Dashboards app in its own page. This epic moves Security to the native Kibana Dashboards app behind a feature flag, ships the Security dashboards as Elastic-managed dashboards, and updates navigation and in-product links.

## Definition of done
- With the flag on, the Dashboards nav item opens the native app and the Security dashboards are installed as managed dashboards.
- With the flag off, nothing changes for users.

elastic/security-team#900201.title: [Security Solution] Feature flag for the native Dashboards migration
elastic/security-team#900201.body:
## Description
Add an experimental feature flag, off by default. Every other ticket of the epic builds behind it.

## Acceptance criteria
- The flag exists and is off by default.

elastic/security-team#900202.title: [Security Solution] Point Security to native Kibana Dashboards: nav, redirects and in-product links
elastic/security-team#900202.body:
## Description
While the flag is on, the Dashboards nav item opens the native Dashboards app directly. Old Security dashboard URLs redirect to the matching managed dashboard. In-product links to Security dashboards point to the native app.

## Acceptance criteria
- The nav item opens the native app in classic, solution and serverless navigation.
- Old URLs redirect; bookmarks keep working.
- With the flag off, the current experience is unchanged.

elastic/security-team#900203.title: [Security Solution] Generic installer for Elastic-managed Security dashboards
elastic/security-team#900203.body:
## Description
Install the bundled Security dashboards as Elastic-managed dashboards on startup, once per space, and upgrade them when the bundled version changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Managed dashboards are installed in every space where Security is enabled.
- A newer bundled version replaces the installed one; user copies are not touched.

elastic/security-team#900800.title: [Epic] Alert assignment at scale
elastic/security-team#900800.body:
## Summary
Let analysts assign and unassign alerts to teammates for any number of alerts, not only the selected rows.

## Definition of success
- Bulk assign and unassign work on the full result set, with progress and error reporting.

elastic/security-team#900801.title: Bulk assign and unassign alerts beyond the 100-alert limit
elastic/security-team#900801.body:
## Background
Assign and unassign act only on selected rows, so the page size (up to 100) caps them, and the actions are disabled when the analyst selects all matching alerts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Assign and unassign are enabled after "Select all N alerts".
- The action runs as a query over the full result set and reports how many alerts were updated or failed.
- Assigning more than 10,000 alerts shows a confirmation first.
